title: Set up your office
nudge: Your office setup isn't finished yet.
noCases: No cases yet: create one in the previous step.

ACCOUNT.title: Your account is ready
ACCOUNT.hint: A few short steps set up your office. You can skip any of them and come back later from the profile menu.

OFFICE.hint: These defaults apply to new cases, invoices and dates.

INVITE.hint: Invite colleagues by email. Each gets a role and a link valid for 7 days.

cases.title: Cases
cases.body: Each case holds its clients, parties, documents, hearings, tasks and billing.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.body: Hearings with reminders 7, 3 and 1 days before, for the office and each lawyer.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: A board per person and per case, with due dates and a daily digest.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.body: Summaries of documents and hearing minutes, always to be checked by a lawyer.

CASE.hint: Open a case with its client and the responsible lawyer.

HEARING.hint: Pick a case and schedule its next hearing; reminders follow the office defaults.

DOCUMENT.hint: Pick a case and upload a document to it.
